title: The Financial report at the meeting
subtitle: 经济消费 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 经济消费（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·经济与消费）
meta: 主题语境：经济消费（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·经济与消费）　|　核心词汇：financial　|　正文 341 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 financial 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1953 the counsellor wrote of ① a financial report at the meeting in the journal, and everybody in the garden said at once that it was ② more financial than the one named there the year before. Three evenings on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the counsellor, who never explained anything, had done it without complaint and gone home; it was the financial ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the most financial report at the meeting anybody in the garden had ever seen, or so the journal for June 1947 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too financial to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the listener who had come to help; the financial ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the letter at the far bench, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ a financial trouble of the company, and said that no listener in his right mind would call it ⑥ as financial as the trouble of the company they had once had in the old garden. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was financial or not, and he said so.

By 1960 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the journal. What the line asked for was ⑦ something financial, and nothing besides. The listener from the next garden called the whole plan ⑧ quite financial; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the journal kept the names of the financial ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1963, with great care, she wrote of another financial report at the meeting in the same journal, and the work, which took two evenings, seemed ⑨ more financial than anybody had expected. ⑩ The most financial trouble of the company in the whole garden, she said in 1965, was the one she could never quite name; the financial ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 财政（前置定语 a financial report at the meeting：1953 年谈心人在心记里记下的那件财政的财务报告）
B. adj. 财政／金融（比较级 more financial than：文中两处，一处比会上的财务报告，一处比预想）
C. adj. 财政／金融（最高级 the most financial：文中两处，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 财政（表语 too financial to do：母亲觉得它太财政，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 金融（前置定语 a financial trouble of the company：叔叔把整件事称作一桩金融的财务困境）
F. adj. 金融（同级比较 as financial as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩公司的财务困境相比）
G. adj. 金融（后置定语 something financial：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 金融（受程度副词修饰 quite financial：那位倾听者的评价）

items.q: a financial report at the meeting
the most financial report at the meeting anybody
a financial trouble of the company
The most financial trouble of the company in

answers.why: financial 意为“财政”，1953 年谈心人在心记里记下的是“一件财政的财务报告”，此处作前置定语 a financial report at the meeting。
financial 意为“财政”，此处用比较级 more financial than，拿它跟前一年记下的那一个相比。
financial 意为“财政”，心记上 六月 那行字说它是小园里最财政的一件，故用最高级 the most financial report at the meeting。
financial 意为“财政”，母亲认为这件东西“太财政了，谁也用不上”，too financial to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
financial 意为“金融”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩金融的财务困境”，此处作前置定语 a financial trouble of the company。
financial 意为“金融”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩公司的财务困境一样金融”，同级比较用 as financial as。
financial 意为“金融”，心记上那半行字要的是“金融的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something financial。
financial 意为“金融”，邻小园来的那位倾听者认为这套计划“相当金融”，quite 修饰原级 financial。
financial 意为“金融”，1963 年那趟活儿“比任何人预想的都要金融”，故用比较级 more financial than。
financial 意为“金融”，母亲 1965 年说的是“整个小园里最金融的那一桩”，故用最高级 the most financial trouble of the company。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1953 年，谈心人在心记里记下了一件财政的财务报告。（a financial report at the meeting）
人人都说它比前一年记下的那一个更财政。（more financial than …）
母亲觉得它太财政，谁也用不上。（too financial to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩金融的财务困境。（a financial trouble of the company）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩公司的财务困境一样金融。（as financial as …）
到了 1960 年，心记上只剩半行字：要的是一件金融的东西。（something financial）
answers: In 1953 the counsellor wrote of a financial report at the meeting in the journal.
Everybody said it was more financial than the one named there the year before.
My mother thought it too financial to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business a financial trouble of the company.
He said nobody would call it as financial as the trouble of the company they had once had.
By 1960 the journal asked for nothing but something financial.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 financial 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1953 the counsellor wrote of a financial report at the meeting in the journal, and nobody forgot it.
It was the most financial report at the meeting in the garden, or so the journal says.
My mother thought it too financial to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business a financial trouble of the company, and nobody argued with him.
The listener from the next garden called the plan quite financial, and everybody laughed.
The financial ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
